create_CustomGuardrail: create a custom guardrail class that validates LLM requests and responses with configurable event hooks
run_raise_passthrough_exception: run a guardrail violation that raises ModifyResponseException to short-circuit the LLM call and return a violation message
test_should_run_guardrail: test whether a guardrail should execute for a given event type based on metadata, default_on, and event_hook configuration
build_apply_guardrail: build guardrail logic that inspects and optionally modifies request or response texts, images, and tool calls
summarize_log_guardrail_information: summarize guardrail execution results by applying the log_guardrail_information decorator to track status, duration, and tracing details
